Stores a single Mozilla Firefox user preference entry for the Normandy system's first-run state.

## Key Components

- **`user_pref("app.normandy.first_run", true)`** — Sets the Normandy experimentation/telemetry system's first-run flag to `true`, indicating the profile has not yet completed initial Normandy setup.

## Usage Example

```javascript
// This file is auto-managed by Firefox. To override preferences,
// create or edit a user.js file in your Firefox profile directory:

// ~/.mozilla/firefox/<profile>/user.js
user_pref("app.normandy.first_run", false); // Disable first-run behavior
```

## Notes

- **Do not edit directly** — changes are overwritten when Firefox exits.
- Modify preferences via `about:config` in the browser or through a `user.js` file in your profile directory.
- This file is unrelated to the FleetMDM codebase and appears to be a Firefox profile artifact included in the repository.

> **Source:** [`prefs2.js`](https://github.com/flamingo-stack/fleetmdm/blob/main/prefs2.js)
